title: Japanese Chicken Ozoni
description: A traditional Japanese soup originating from the Hokkaido region, typically served at New Year's. This recipe replaces the traditional mochi with roasted chicken.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a large pot, combine dashi broth, miso paste, soy sauce, sake, and sugar. Whisk until the miso paste is dissolved.
Slice the roasted chicken into thin strips.
Add the sliced chicken to the pot and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in chopped green onions and shredded daikon, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
